rollback_steps: Record the running image IDs, health, restart counts, Paper order count and repository release tag.
Verify all rollback image references resolve to the recorded digests; abort on mismatch.
Retain CRYPTO_BOT_ENV_FILE, CRYPTO_BOT_DATA_DIR and CRYPTO_BOT_NETWORK; change only approved image override names.
Run docker compose config --quiet with the versioned base and overlay; abort on validation failure.
Under separate deployment approval, replace only allowlisted services, one at a time and with --no-deps; never activate the ultimate-bot or legacy-dashboard profiles.
Require healthy status, bounded restart count and unchanged Paper orders after each service.
Restore release image references if rollback validation fails; never modify or restore databases.
prohibited_actions: database migration, rebuild, deletion or restore
credential or runtime environment value capture
